records.exact_value: Engage your core and unrack the barbell, stepping back to clear the rack.
records.problem: Free-bar walk-out boilerplate is mechanically incompatible with the Smith bar remaining on guide rails.
records.resolution: Use exact catalogue Smith-bar instructions: planted stance, guided bar across upper back, hip/knee flexion then extension. No walk-out or horizontal translation. Dataset original kept verbatim.
